query: Digital Realty AI data center leasing bookings latest quarter
normalized: ai bookings center data digital leasing quarter realty

output.content:
Digital Realty’s latest reported quarter is **2Q 2026** (results released July 23, 2026). It signed **$307 million of total leasing bookings** measured as expected annualized GAAP base rent at 100% ownership; this equated to **$208 million at Digital Realty’s share**. [[1]] 

The release does **not** disclose a separate dollar figure labeled “AI leasing bookings.” The closest AI-relevant indicators are its **hyperscale-oriented capacity** strategy and **$108 million of 0–1 MW plus interconnection bookings**—comprising **$88 million** from 0–1 MW leases and **$20 million** from interconnection—which management said exceeded $100 million for the first time. [[1]] 

For context, bookings fell from the unusually large **$707 million at 100% share / $423 million at Digital Realty’s share** in 1Q 2026, a quarter that included the company’s largest-ever hyperscale lease. [[2]]
